confirmation_extension.selection_basis: Both voices' completed screening selected n50-top2. Add the largest-sample extreme-tail candidates before reading any confirmation outcomes, to test whether the screening's apparent diminishing returns transfer to fresh tasks.
confirmation_extension.validation: Same 40 new confirmation text/emotion/language/seed blocks and exact same 4/4/2 batches. Reuse already-generated matched no-steering controls; do not regenerate, drop or choose controls. Additional takes are recorded in the same confirmation ledger with separate condition IDs.
confirmation_extension.comparisons: Each additional candidate minus n50-top2, and n200-top1 minus n200-top2, paired on fresh confirmation blocks. The first-study winner provides the smaller/older-data comparator (Mira N20 Top10, Osku N10 Top10, each derived from ten rather than twenty cells). Quality/emotion gates unchanged. These are prespecified diagnostic confirmations, not a second winner-selection search.
